## Problem

What workflow would this improve?

## Proposed Solution

What should videogen do?

For provider/model changes, include the region and official documentation link. Describe any expected queue, cost-estimate or recovery behavior.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you tried another approach?

## Privacy Notes

If your request includes screenshots or examples, remove API keys, proxy credentials, full personal paths, private prompts, remote task IDs, signed result URLs and private media. Use synthetic examples; do not attach a real task data directory.
